posts.content: Let's all cooperate this game. Mutual cooperation earns 3 per round for everyone, far more than the 1 from mutual defection. I will cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me, and I will respond in kind to anyone who defects.

Note (P6, good): Round 1 vs P2, no info. Plan: cooperate first, then play tit-for-tat against opponents, and defect against anyone who has defected. Watch leader P3's messages against my own encounter results. Prior: expected selfish about 3 of 9 others, so about 0.33 each. Update beliefs as defections are observed.

Round 1 went well for me: mutual cooperation with my opponent. Let's keep it going. I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me and will answer defection with defection. Steady C earns 3 per round for everyone.

Note (P6, good): Round 2 vs P9, no history with P9. Cooperated with P2 in round 1 and got C,C. Leader P3 urged cooperation; consistent so far but unverified. Plan: cooperate with P9 as a first meeting, then tit-for-tat; defect against anyone who has defected on me. Keep beliefs near prior, lowering for P2 slightly.
Rounds 1 and 2 gave me mutual cooperation. Let's keep it going: steady C earns 3 per round for everyone. I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me, and I will answer defection with defection.

Note (P6, good): Round 3 vs P8, first meeting, no history. Cooperated with P2 and P9, both C,C. Leader P3's claims are consistent so far but unverified. Plan: cooperate with P8, then tit-for-tat; defect against anyone who defects on me. Keep beliefs near prior, slightly lower for P2 and P9.

Rounds 1-3 gave me mutual cooperation every time. Let's keep it going: steady C earns 3 per round for everyone. I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me, and I will answer defection with defection.

Note (P6, good): Round 4 vs P1, first meeting, no history. All 3 encounters so far were C,C (P2, P9, P8). Leader P3 keeps urging cooperation; consistent but unverified. Plan: cooperate with P1 as a first meeting, then tit-for-tat; defect against anyone who defects on me. Keep beliefs near prior, slightly lower for P2, P8, P9. Be more wary near the end, since selfish players may defect in the last rounds.

Rounds 1-4 gave me mutual cooperation every time. Let's keep it going: steady C earns 3 per round for everyone. I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me, and I will answer defection with defection.

Rounds 1-6 gave me mutual cooperation every time. Let's keep it going: steady C earns 3 per round for everyone. I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me, and I will answer defection with defection.

Note (P6, good): Round 7 vs P3 (leader), first meeting. All 6 encounters so far were C,C. P3's public messages urge cooperation and are consistent with my results, though unverified. Plan: cooperate with P3, then tit-for-tat; defect against anyone who defects on me. Stay wary in rounds 9-10 since selfish players may defect late. Keep beliefs near prior, slightly lower for players who have cooperated with me.

Rounds 1-7 gave me mutual cooperation every time. Let's keep it going: steady C earns 3 per round for everyone. I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me, and I will answer defection with defection.

Note (P6, good): Round 8 vs P5, first meeting, no history. All 7 encounters so far were C,C. Leader P3's messages are consistent with my results. Plan: cooperate with P5 as a first meeting, then tit-for-tat. Stay wary in rounds 9-10 since selfish players may defect late. P5 and P10 are unmet and stay near prior, about 0.32.

Rounds 1-8 gave me mutual cooperation every time. Let's keep it going through the end: steady C earns 3 per round for everyone. I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me, and I will answer defection with defection.

Note (P6, good): Round 9 vs P10, first meeting, no history. All 8 encounters so far were C,C. Leader P3's messages are consistent with my results. Plan: cooperate with P10, since a selfish player may defect late but I have no evidence, and tit-for-tat afterward. Stay wary in round 10. P10 is unmet, so keep it near 0.3. Others who cooperated stay lower, about 0.2.
Round 10, final round. Everyone has cooperated with me in rounds 1-9, thank you. Cooperation has earned 3 per round for all of us, so let's finish the same way.

Note (P6, good): Round 10 vs P10, rematch. Round 9 was C,C. All 9 encounters were C,C. Leader P3's messages are consistent with my results. Last round: defecting gains me only +2 but costs P10 3 if P10 is good, and I want to maximize total for good players. Plan: cooperate with P10 unless the leader's message suggests otherwise. Beliefs: keep around 0.2-0.3 for all others, P10 about 0.3.
